purpose: AskTab user-message visual concepts, light and dark themes

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, pixel-sharp high-fidelity UI concept image for AskTab, a real browser AI chat side panel. This is a product design exploration of USER MESSAGE styling for long Markdown. The current large saturated blue user message is overwhelming; the new design must be quiet, readable and realistic to implement.
Composition: wide design board, approximately 1600 x 1200 pixels. Exactly TWO equally sized tall browser side-panel screenshots side by side, left LIGHT theme and right DARK theme of the SAME design. Plain neutral board background, crisp flat front-on UI, no laptop or phone hardware, no perspective, no decorative illustrations. Large short concept heading above panels, small labels LIGHT and DARK. UI panels occupy most of the canvas. Show the entire top header and bottom composer. The screens must look like narrow 420px browser side panels, not smartphone apps.
Shared invariant layout: compact 56px header with menu icon, AskTab wordmark, small blue "+ 新会话" button and an expand icon. A long right-positioned user message using 88% of the conversation width, all text within the message LEFT-aligned. A small right-aligned "你 · 14:32" label just above it. Below it an assistant message with small outlined assistant avatar and "AskTab", no enclosing bubble. An anchored rounded multiline composer at the bottom with placeholder "继续提问…", paperclip bottom left, small neutral "GPT" model chip, blue send-arrow square bottom right.
Keep the SAME message content and approximate geometry in both themes. Faithfully RENDER Markdown styles, no literal ** or # symbols except inside the code example. User content in Chinese, exact content:
large H1 "帮我优化这个页面"
body "请保留现有功能，重点改善长消息的阅读体验。"
H2 "设计要求"
three bullets "保留标题、加粗和列表层次" / "长文本也能轻松阅读" / "代码和表格保持清晰"
Render the words "长文本" in bold in the second bullet.
A subtle blockquote "蓝色用于强调，不再铺满整条消息。"
A code block with small language label "CSS", copy icon, and three monospaced lines:
.message {
  line-height: 1.6;
}
A compact two-column table with headings "内容" and "呈现方式", rows "正文 | 高对比文字" and "代码 | 独立浅色区".
Small copy and edit icons beneath user message.
Assistant response: "可以。我们先降低背景色的存在感，再用间距和字重建立层次。"
Typography: clean Chinese sans serif, legible at small sizes, strong heading hierarchy, comfortable line-height, deep charcoal body in light theme, pale gray body in dark theme. Spacious but realistic compact UI. Code block and table must have neutral theme-appropriate surfaces and thin borders, NEVER blue fills. ALL typography must remain readable. Use brand blue #006CFF only for small buttons, selected accents and tiny identification marks, under 3% of the total screen area. NO giant colored user surface, NO gradients, NO glow, NO purple, NO illustration, NO spurious decorative UI, NO full blue header.
Specific concept A: A quiet conventional CHAT BUBBLE. Title on board exactly "A / 雾灰气泡". Light screen pure white background; user message a very pale cool NEUTRAL GRAY #F3F4F6 rounded bubble, 16px corner radius, generous 16px internal padding, NO visible border, NO shadow, NO accent stripe. Main text #20252D, subdued labels #7A818C. Code block slightly deeper neutral gray #E8EBEF with a fine gray border. Dark screen #141619 background with user bubble #25282D, text #E8EBEF, code panel #1C1F23. A distinctly neutral grayscale bubble, visibly not pale blue. Blue only tiny action controls. The silhouette should retain the familiarity of chat while the large surface becomes visually quiet.

Specific concept B: A PAPER CARD FOR LONG MESSAGES. Title on board exactly "B / 白卡细边框". Light conversation canvas #F6F7F9, user card pure white, crisp thin #DDE2E8 outline, 12px corners, almost invisible shadow. A tiny 24px blue horizontal dash sits beside the "你" role label OUTSIDE the card. No colored accent stripe running the full height. Keep message area overwhelmingly white, text #20252D, Markdown margins carefully editorial. Code block #F4F5F7 and table pure white with very thin row separators. Dark conversation canvas #15171A, card #1D2024, 1px #353B44 border, text #E7E9ED, code block #15181C. Small blue role dash remains the only role accent. Card boundaries provide ownership without color saturation. It should look slightly more structured and suited to long technical content than a conventional chat bubble.
